title: Leaderboard
summary: In-place L1 feature pack: a capability facade over one leaderboard backend (portal, anonymous HTTP or mock), per-board per-scope score coalescing, four-kind refusal semantics, the pure day/wire/place core and the opaque extra codec. The game persists the pack's keys through a host seam and draws rows from a view.
dependencies: engine nt_base64 for the HTTP payload encoding
features/platform-sdk leaderboard and auth entry points for the portal backend
provides: leaderboard_caps and leaderboard_ui_state: what a screen may show, per board, answered live
leaderboard_submit per (board, scope) with sort-aware coalescing and an already-sent guard
leaderboard_view_t rows with an opaque extra payload and no game concept
refusal semantics: UNSUPPORTED latches per capability, NEEDS_LOGIN flags, RATE_LIMITED and FAILED recover
leaderboard_host_t: the pack persists nothing itself
the pure core: UTC day math, payload encoding, response parsing, place re-estimation
mock backend for tests and local development

flags.testing: LEADERBOARD_TESTING exposes leaderboard_reset_for_tests and the test clock

registers.note: Describes the template's existing in-place wiring.
